# Licence expressions accepted for crates linked into the native ai-guard binaries.
# Checked by `cargo run --example third_party_notices -- check|notices --allowed <this file>` (CI and release).
# Line forms: an accepted SPDX expression; `no-expression: NAME VERSION`; `no-text: NAME VERSION`.
# A Cargo.lock change that brings an expression not listed here fails CI: review the new licence
# (copyleft obligations, redistribution, attribution) and add the exact expression in the same change.
# Initial list generated from Cargo.lock on 2026-11-21 (350 crates, all features). Every expression is
# permissive, or offers a permissive alternative joined by OR (the LGPL-2.1-or-later alternatives are
# not relied on). This is a first review by the release lot, not legal advice: maintainers confirm it.
(MIT OR Apache-2.0) AND Unicode-3.0
0BSD OR MIT OR Apache-2.0
Apache-2.0
Apache-2.0 AND ISC
Apache-2.0 OR BSL-1.0
Apache-2.0 OR ISC OR MIT
Apache-2.0 OR MIT
Apache-2.0 WITH LLVM-exception OR Apache-2.0 OR MIT
BSD-2-Clause OR Apache-2.0 OR MIT
BSD-3-Clause
CDLA-Permissive-2.0
ISC
MIT
MIT AND BSD-3-Clause
MIT OR Apache-2.0
MIT OR Apache-2.0 OR BSD-1-Clause
MIT OR Apache-2.0 OR LGPL-2.1-or-later
MIT OR Apache-2.0 OR Zlib
MIT OR Zlib OR Apache-2.0
MIT/Apache-2.0
Unicode-3.0
Unlicense OR MIT
Unlicense/MIT
Zlib
Zlib OR Apache-2.0 OR MIT

# Crates whose published package ships no licence text. Their SPDX expression is listed in the notices
# table and in a dedicated section. OPEN for the maintainers: fetch the upstream licence text and ship it
# (or replace the crate) before a release that claims complete attribution.
no-text: keyed_priority_queue 0.4.2
no-text: r-efi 5.3.0
no-text: r-efi 6.0.0
no-text: rsqlite-vfs 0.2.0
